annotations.title: Get a content item and its post status

description:
[read-only] One content item plus its live posting status: `postState` and `posts[]` (up to 20, newest first) with each post's status (scheduled · publishing · published · partial · failed · review_held · held), scheduledAt, and per-platform status, live URL and error. The item's own `status` stays "draft" after publishing — read `posts` to know whether it is live. Use this to confirm a publish landed.
(Wraps GET /api/v2/content/{id}.)
name: get_content
title: Get a content item and its post status
